fields.statement: At leaf commit 87779b63e: go test -trimpath -p 2 -count=1 -v ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/^(bugfix-workflow-autonomous|plan-workflow-autonomous-left|plan-workflow-autonomous|plan-review-workflow)$' exit 0, subtests 3.01, 5.04, 3.03, 2.51 s (all under 15 s; were 91, 64, 59, 58 s).
